prompt: Giant sprite frame: death fall, facing north. Faithfully re-render the attached single sprite frame. Preserve the exact pose, screen-facing direction, character identity, anatomy, equipment, silhouette, palette, pixel clusters, outline thickness, and apparent character scale from the reference. Keep the entire character centered and uncropped. Use a perfectly flat pure white (#FFFFFF) background for later transparency extraction. No floor, cast shadow, glow, checkerboard, text, frame, or extra objects. Crisp hard-edged 2D pixel art; no blur.

normalization.method: foreground crop, nearest-neighbor resize to phase-matched reference height, reference-anchor placement
normalization.backgroundRemovalLimit: near-white character details sharing the matte color are removed

visualReview.note: Normalized candidate only; visual and sequence review is pending.
